questions.question: Which desert is the largest hot desert in the world?
questions.fun_fact: While Antarctica is technically the largest desert overall due to its low precipitation, the Sahara is the largest hot desert.

questions.question: What is the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.fun_fact: Mitochondria generate most of the chemical energy needed to power the cell's biochemical reactions.

questions.question: Who was the second President of the United States?
questions.fun_fact: John Adams served as the nation's second president from 1797 to 1801 after serving as the first vice president under George Washington.

questions.question: Which 1999 science fiction film popularized the 'bullet time' visual effect and stars Keanu Reeves as Neo?
questions.fun_fact: The Matrix was written and directed by the Wachowskis and won four Academy Awards.

questions.question: Roquefort cheese, known for its distinct blue veins and sharp flavor, is made primarily from the milk of which animal?
questions.fun_fact: True Roquefort is aged in the natural caves of Combalou in Roquefort-sur-Soulzon, France, using ewes' milk.

questions.question: What is a baby kangaroo commonly called?
questions.fun_fact: A newborn joey is remarkably tiny, about the size of a honeybee or a grape, when it climbs into its mother's pouch.

questions.question: In bowling, what term is used to describe scoring three consecutive strikes?
questions.fun_fact: The term 'turkey' in bowling dates back to the 1920s when promoters would award a live turkey to any bowler who rolled three strikes in a row near Thanksgiving.

questions.question: What is the term for a word that is spelled the same forwards and backwards, such as 'racecar'?
questions.fun_fact: The longest single-word palindrome in standard English is often considered to be 'tattarrattat', coined by James Joyce in Ulysses.

questions.question: Which planet in our solar system has the most prominent and complex ring system visible from Earth?
questions.fun_fact: Saturn's rings are composed mostly of chunks of water ice with lesser amounts of rocky debris and dust.

questions.question: Ulaanbaatar is the capital city of which sovereign nation?
questions.fun_fact: Ulaanbaatar is known as the world's coldest national capital due to its high elevation and sub-arctic climate.
